elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “Client owns all deliverables and work product created for Client under this Agreement.”

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink “hereby assigns the same to Client.”

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The assignment is limited to deliverables and work product created for Client; TrueLink expressly retains its Interface rights, and embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property is licensed rather than assigned.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property licence is expressly “perpetual.”

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property licence is expressly “irrevocable.”

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property licence is expressly “royalty-free.”

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Client retains “all right, title and interest” in Client Content, Credit Data, and all other data provided by or for Client or its customers.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: TrueLink’s Credit Data licence is limited to use, upload, copy, and storage “solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services.”

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause states: “Neither party owns any intellectual property jointly with the other.”

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: TrueLink retains the Interface and licenses embedded TrueLink IP, but the clause does not preserve ownership of generic tools and know-how as such.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables outright, and the necessary licence to embedded TrueLink IP is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables outright, and the necessary licence to embedded TrueLink IP is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Neither the deliverables ownership language nor the embedded TrueLink IP licence expressly provides a worldwide licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables outright, and the necessary licence to embedded TrueLink IP is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink IP licence permits use as part of the deliverables but does not expressly permit modification, including modification for Client’s business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: No sublicensing right is granted for the embedded TrueLink IP, so Client lacks an express right to sublicense the complete deliverables.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: TrueLink’s Credit Data licence is limited to use, upload, copy, and storage “solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services.”
